description:
MUST:  
 J2EE/Java core basics, 
 Multithreading, 
 Spring, 
 Hibernate, and 
 Collections (ex like list, Hashmap)
  
 As a member of Services Technology Incubation Center, you will be responsible for design and development of flexible and robust integration solutions for a diverse set of applications and databases. This position requires a strong background in implementing middle tier applications.
 Responsibilities 
 Work closely with other SW Engineers to design, develop, integrate and support STIC next generation knowledge platform for technical services.
 Design and develop integration solutions from multi-vendor systems
 Author software design specifications
 Unit and Integration testing
 Ability to research, propose and prototype new principles, technologies, tools and concepts and integrate them into the teams collective knowledge
 Skills Required 
 5 -10 years of application integration with emphasis on following tools and technologies.
 Development, deployment and management of a medium to large multi-vendor based integrated production systems
 Object-Relational mapping tools/technologies
 Development, analysis and test experience with highly scalable platforms
 Must have strong working knowledge in
 SOA, RESTful WebServices
 XMLBeans,
 J2EE middle tier and J2EE Application containers like Spring Framework , Hibernate
 AXIS, Tomcat, Web Services
 Development experience on UNIX or Linux
 Unit testing frameworks such as JUnit, JMock
 The following optional skills would be a plus :       
 Experience with commercial messaging tools such as Tibco
 AngularJS and Front-end Development.
 
 GC or USC. 
 H1B exception, if on our payroll. No sub-vendorship (c2c). According to our client's stipulation. 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
